session.description: Opaque Backend-issued session credential; never a JWT and never readable by browser JavaScript.

info.description: Inscription-first, read-only access to the public Catalog, plus the Community V1 current-user identity. Operational health is unversioned; public contracts use /v1.
info.title: 由艺（Yoyi）Public API

get.description: Unversioned operational endpoint. Query parameters are not accepted.

200.description: Service is ready.

503.description: Service is temporarily unavailable; error code SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.

get.description: Only kind, page, and pageSize are accepted. Unknown, duplicate, or invalid query parameters return INVALID_QUERY.

200.description: A page of public Catalog entries.

500.description: Internal service error; error code INTERNAL_ERROR.

503.description: Service is temporarily unavailable; error code SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.

get.description: Required nonblank q (at most 200 UTF-16 code units), optional kind/page/pageSize. Unknown, duplicate or invalid parameters return INVALID_QUERY. Fixed OpenCC 1.4.1 t2s normalization and whitespace-separated same-record AND; percent, underscore and backslash are literal. Original title exact, existing alias exact, normalized exact, title/alias partial, structured and body tiers apply before deterministic CatalogId pagination. No typo correction, unapproved variants, historicalContext or scholarlyResearch. Missing/stale derived data is SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, never an empty-result fallback.

200.description: A page of ordered Catalog search results with truthful matchKind; query text is not echoed.

500.description: Internal service error; error code INTERNAL_ERROR.

503.description: Service is temporarily unavailable; error code SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.

get.description: Catalog detail lookup accepts no query parameters.

parameters.description: Opaque platform CatalogId.
parameters.name: catalogId

200.description: The requested public Catalog entry.

404.description: Catalog entry not found; error code ITEM_NOT_FOUND.

500.description: Internal service error; error code INTERNAL_ERROR.

503.description: Service is temporarily unavailable; error code SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.

get.description: Anonymous read returning one combined list: `hot`, at most three visible root comments ranked by their number of currently visible replies (positive scores only; ties to the newer comment, then the greater id), followed by `items`, the remaining visible roots newest first. A root never appears in both. Each root carries a bounded first page of its visible replies (oldest first) and its visible reply total. Without `pinned` the hot section is selected afresh; a load-more request passes the hot ids it already holds as `pinned`, receives an empty `hot` and pages the latest list with exactly those roots excluded, so the sequence neither repeats nor drops a root when the hot selection moves. Offset pagination is still not stable under concurrent inserts; a client refreshes the whole list to resynchronize. Pending and hidden items never count and never appear.

parameters.description: Opaque platform CatalogId of a currently published record.
parameters.name: catalogId

200.description: The hot section and one page of the latest visible comments.

404.description: The Catalog record or root comment is not available; error code ITEM_NOT_FOUND.

500.description: Internal service error; error code INTERNAL_ERROR.

503.description: Service is temporarily unavailable; error code SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.

get.summary: List visible comments on one Catalog record

post.description: Requires the session credential. Plain text only, trimmed and bounded; no rich text, mentions, links, media or attachments. Under PRE_MODERATION the comment enters moderation and the response is 202.

parameters.description: Opaque platform CatalogId of a currently published record.
parameters.name: catalogId

202.description: The created comment. It entered moderation under PRE_MODERATION and is not visible until the Owner approves it.

401.description: A valid session is required; error code UNAUTHENTICATED.

404.description: The Catalog record or root comment is not available; error code ITEM_NOT_FOUND.

422.description: The submitted body is invalid; error code INVALID_INPUT.

500.description: Internal service error; error code INTERNAL_ERROR.

503.description: Service is temporarily unavailable; error code SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.

post.summary: Create a comment on one Catalog record

get.description: Anonymous read supporting bounded load-more. Reply depth is one: a reply never owns children, and a reply under a root that is not visible is never returned.

parameters.description: Opaque platform CatalogId of a currently published record.
parameters.name: catalogId

parameters.description: Opaque platform id of a visible root comment.
parameters.name: commentId

200.description: A page of visible replies.

get.summary: List visible replies under one root comment

post.description: Requires the session credential. An answer to a sibling reply stays a sibling under the same root and carries its author as replyTo. Under PRE_MODERATION the reply enters moderation and the response is 202.

parameters.description: Opaque platform CatalogId of a currently published record.
parameters.name: catalogId

parameters.description: Opaque platform id of a visible root comment.
parameters.name: commentId

get.description: Identifies the session owner behind the opaque bearer credential that the same-origin Web route relays from its HttpOnly cookie. Accepts no query parameters. Sessions are issued, validated, expired and revoked only by the Backend; Production has no sign-in path until a provider is separately authorized.

200.description: The session owner's public profile.

401.description: Missing, malformed, expired, revoked or suspended session; error code UNAUTHENTICATED.

500.description: Internal service error; error code INTERNAL_ERROR.

503.description: Service is temporarily unavailable; error code SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE.
